01
Fine print

Find the tiny detail

THE QUESTION

What is the Calibration reference in the SERVICE & TRACEABILITY section of this product specification poster? Return only the exact code.

MODEL ANSWERCAL-7Q4M-82K6gpt-6-astra · recorded case

A ViewCraft skill

φ

What to see

Start with the whole poster. Zoom only when the requested field is too small, keeping its label and section heading in the crop.

ψ

How to arrange it

Keep the overview beside useful recent crops. Preserve original characters and source coordinates.

θ

How to read it

Match section and label, then transcribe the exact code. Preserve case, hyphens and leading zeros.

One reusable way to look.
One procedure that knows how to read it.

02
Forms

Read the right field

THE QUESTION

What is the purchase order number on this invoice?

MODEL ANSWERPO-48271gpt-6-astra · recorded case

A ViewCraft skill

φ

What to see

Read the complete form before choosing a value. If needed, crop the label and value together.

ψ

How to arrange it

Keep columns, field boundaries and the page overview intact so neighboring identifiers stay distinct.

θ

How to read it

Pair the requested label with its own value. Check nearby fields before returning the exact identifier.

One reusable way to look.
One procedure that knows how to read it.

03
Charts

Let the chart speak

THE QUESTION

In March, how many more physical books than digital books were borrowed? Answer with the number only.

MODEL ANSWER55gpt-6-astra · recorded case

A ViewCraft skill

φ

What to see

Keep original colors, category labels and axis units. Inspect a bar pair or legend only when it is unclear.

ψ

How to arrange it

Preserve the full chart as context; retain the legend and nearby ticks in detail views.

θ

How to read it

Match the series to its legend, read values with units, then compute the requested comparison.

One reusable way to look.
One procedure that knows how to read it.

04
Tables

Follow the right rows

THE QUESTION

What is the total number of units for orders where Depot is North, Category is Kits, and Status is Shipped? Add the Units column for matching rows only. Return only the number.

MODEL ANSWER90gpt-6-astra · recorded case

A ViewCraft skill

φ

What to see

Read headers before numbers. Crop a row with its identifier, filter fields and target measure when necessary.

ψ

How to arrange it

Preserve row alignment and column structure. Keep the overview available while checking a detail.

θ

How to read it

Apply every filter, collect values from the correct column, and verify the selected rows before summing.

One reusable way to look.
One procedure that knows how to read it.

05
Counting

Count without losing track

THE QUESTION

How many orange triangles are there across all four compartments? Count only pieces that are both orange and triangular. Answer with only the integer.

MODEL ANSWER7gpt-6-astra · recorded case

A ViewCraft skill

φ

What to see

Keep true RGB colors and object contours. Inspect only shapes whose color or boundary remains ambiguous.

ψ

How to arrange it

Use the scene's compartments or nonoverlapping scan bands. A crop shows existing objects, not new ones.

θ

How to read it

Match both color and shape. Count region by region, check boundaries, then combine the subtotals.

One reusable way to look.
One procedure that knows how to read it.

06
Before & after

Spot what changed

THE QUESTION

The first image is BEFORE and the second image is AFTER. Exactly one item has moved on this desk; all other items stayed in place. Which item moved? Answer only with its color and common object name.

MODEL ANSWERTeal muggpt-6-astra · recorded case

A ViewCraft skill

φ

What to see

Keep the input order, colors and aspect ratios. Compare both scenes before requesting matched detail crops.

ψ

How to arrange it

Place the two views in an indexed, two-column comparison sheet while retaining source identities.

θ

How to read it

Align stable landmarks. For a moved object, confirm both its old location and its new location.

One reusable way to look.
One procedure that knows how to read it.

07
Time & events

Put the story in order

THE QUESTION

In this sequence, what happened immediately before the box was taped shut at 00:12? Answer with the letter of the matching event.

MODEL ANSWERBgpt-6-astra · recorded case

A ViewCraft skill

φ

What to see

Retain the supplied event frames and timestamps. Inspect a specific source frame only when the event is unclear.

ψ

How to arrange it

Arrange frames in a three-column, time-labeled sheet. Read timestamps rather than guessing from tile position.

θ

How to read it

Locate the anchor event, then inspect its immediate neighbor. Distinguish an action from a persistent state.

One reusable way to look.
One procedure that knows how to read it.

08
Motion

Notice who stayed still

THE QUESTION

Which labeled objects remained at the same position in every one of the five frames? An object that moves and returns to its starting position does not count. Return only the labels in alphabetical order, separated by a comma and a space.

MODEL ANSWERB, Dgpt-6-astra · recorded case

A ViewCraft skill

φ

What to see

Keep all supplied frames in time order. Preserve the scene's colors and object identities.

ψ

How to arrange it

Use a time-labeled contact sheet so the same object can be compared across several moments.

θ

How to read it

Track every object's position relative to stable landmarks. Returning to the start does not mean staying still.

One reusable way to look.
One procedure that knows how to read it.

MODEL ANSWER260gpt-6-astra · recorded case

A ViewCraft skill

φ

What to see

ψ

θ

10
Interfaces

Point to the right control

THE QUESTION

Locate the Retry button in the Meridian sync row whose environment is Production. Return its center as normalized (x, y) coordinates in the original screenshot.

MODEL ANSWER0.8903, 0.7805gpt-6-astra · recorded case

A ViewCraft skill

φ

What to see

Inspect the original screenshot. Crop only when a repeated label or control is too small to distinguish.

ψ

How to arrange it

Preserve source geometry and individually addressable views. Never rearrange interface fragments into a sheet.

θ

How to read it

Match the row and section qualifiers, then choose the control's center and return a normalized source point.

One reusable way to look.
One procedure that knows how to read it.
